execution.wait: poll processed_count() every 2 ms; deadline = 60 s + 0.5 s x columns per epoch; timeout raises (no partial data)
execution.adaptation: one fresh GraphEye(n_az=1) per adaptation entry; 20 adapting epochs then 1 test epoch, each epoch waited until processed_count() == epoch before the next submit

arm_b_declarations.angular_error: angle (deg) between theory (RG,BY) and eye (red_green, blue_yellow) as 2-vectors; undefined (reported, excluded) if either vector is exactly zero
arm_b_declarations.angular_error_ci: percentile bootstrap of mean and median, B=10000, numpy default_rng(20261004) (Arm B stage declaration; A1-4 declares no CI for angular error); descriptive only
arm_b_declarations.calibration: per intensity: Pearson & Spearman of theory rg_rel=(L-M)/(L+M) vs eye red_green (and by_rel vs blue_yellow) on mono_sweep+boundary_dense; through-origin slope per intensity; residual vs a through-origin slope fitted on TRAIN mono 1000 q only, binned by td over HELDOUT_core distinct items. Descriptive; feeds no decoder.
arm_b_declarations.decomposition: theory(CIE) -> Gaussian-linear on expected quanta (sensitivity mismatch) -> Gaussian-linear on submitted integer packets, read from eye caught_quanta (quantisation) -> eye activations (Naka-Rushton). Linear opponent = (cL-cM, cS-0.5(cL+cM)). Angles per leg.
arm_b_declarations.eyelid_reference: for each eyelid stimulus, monochromatic 610 nm and 640 nm references at the eyelid stimulus's at-retina td (quanta = 1000 x td / td(1000 q)), plus 640 nm at the eyelid stimulus's packets_total quanta; cumulative rounding (single bin).

verdict_rules.P1: Arm A only: sign/anchor decoders beat chance = one-sided exact p vs majority < 0.05 on HELDOUT mono_sweep and on reflectance; graceful = sign accuracy non-decreasing over the distance bins (1000 q). supported if all hold for at least one decoder, else mixed/not.
verdict_rules.P2: (a) theory-eye label agreement >= 0.90 on clear-chromatic items (TRAIN + HELDOUT_core distinct; sign margin >= 0.10 / anchor margin >= 10 deg) for both decoders; (b) agreement within +-20 nm of 554.08 nm (mono+boundary) lower than (a) for both decoders; (c) the documented sources account for the eye: replica == eye within 1e-12 on every unadapted stimulus and near-boundary median quantisation leg < 0.10 x median total error. supported = a,b,c; not supported = none; else mixed.
verdict_rules.P3: supported if >= 1 metamer pair has eye opponent gap > 1e-6 (activation units).
verdict_rules.P4: per condition (wrong_optics vs its unfiltered D65 bases; wrong_observer 10deg vs 2deg on the same bases): degrade = median theory-eye angular error higher AND neither decoder's theory accuracy higher. supported = both degrade; mixed = one; not supported = neither.
verdict_rules.P5: supported if eye red_green > 0 for all 27 eyelid stimuli; not supported if any <= 0 (per-OD_long breakdown reported).

batched_vs_fresh_equivalence.note: deterministic-repeat check (same packets, different eye/column count), not independent trials

repeat_structure.wrong_observer: eye values reused from the base stimulus (identical_to); not new eye inputs
repeat_structure.intensity_variants: distinct eye inputs (different packets); not repeats
repeat_structure.poisson: genuine independent trials (distinct seeded packet draws); the only source of variance
repeat_structure.everything_else: single deterministic evaluation; no variance is claimed

calibration.note: theory rg_rel is a scale-free cone contrast; the eye red_green is an activation difference. A linear (no Naka-Rushton) eye would show equal slopes at all intensities; slope changes with intensity are the nonlinearity signature. Descriptive only.

P1.prediction: Arm A beats chance on HELD-OUT monochromatic and reflected stimuli; accuracy degrades gracefully approaching the RG zero-crossing.

P2.prediction: Arm B labels agree with Arm A on the clearly-chromatic stimuli; agreement drops near the boundary and the angular error there is dominated by the Naka-Rushton nonlinearity + Gaussian-vs-CIE mismatch.

P3.prediction: The eye breaks at least some CIE metamers by a measurable opponent gap.

P4.prediction: Theory predictions degrade under wrong-observer/wrong-optics conditions.

P5.prediction: The closed-eyelid stimulus drives the eye to positive red_green at every tested ambient intensity and across the OD_long ablation.
